paper.title: Memento: Fine-tuning LLM Agents without Fine-tuning LLMs
paper.central_claim: A frozen-LLM planner-executor agent with an online-growing episodic case bank and a learned case-retrieval Q-policy (memory-based online RL, M-MDP) continually improves deep-research performance without fine-tuning the LLM: GAIA val 87.88% Pass@3 / test 79.40%, DeepResearcher 66.6 F1 / 80.4 PM, case memory adds 4.7-9.6 points on OOD sets.

signatures.object: Case Bank (task state s, final plan a, binary success r) in the planner prompt; frozen GPT-4.1 planner / o3 or o4-mini executor
signatures.information: Task text; stored cases incl. failures; reward = task success label at task completion; executor/tool traces are not stored in the bank
signatures.operation: Write: append (s,a,r) after completion (final step only). Read: top-K (K=4) cases by SimCSE cosine (non-parametric) or by learned Q (parametric) are concatenated into the planning prompt
signatures.output: Updated case bank; plan conditioned on retrieved cases
signatures.conditions: Binary reward; single-step planning view; memory initialised empty (GAIA) or from other datasets (OOD)
signatures.selection_rule: None for admission (all cases kept); retrieval by similarity or Q-rank, top-K
signatures.selection_data: all stored cases; bank grows during evaluation iterations
signatures.persistence: Vector store of cases; no TTL/dedup/retirement
signatures.failure_boundary: K>4 adds noise; saturation after few iterations; no curation of a growing bank; Level-3 GAIA tasks weak

signatures.object: Retrieval policy Q(s,c;theta): 2-layer MLP over frozen SimCSE embeddings (non-LLM weights)
signatures.information: (state, retrieved case, reward) triples from a replay buffer
signatures.operation: Online BCE update toward the success label of the retrieved case; Read uses TopK of Q
signatures.conditions: single-step collapse (no bootstrapping); credit is per (s,c) pair, no memory-off counterfactual
signatures.claimed_effect: Parametric CBR above non-parametric CBR in Table 4 (+0.6 to +1.0)

assessment.evidence_level_note: Later tasks read cases written from earlier tasks, and 'Memento w/o CBR' is a same-system store-off control on three benchmarks; the OOD protocol and the val-built bank reused on the hidden GAIA test add held-out use, but no memory-off arm exists on the held-out GAIA test and the OOD per-benchmark values are figure-only. Not improver (the retriever's Q is trained, but no comparable-budget evidence that the improved retriever yields better later changes beyond <1 point over kNN).
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported single runs: appending (task, plan, outcome) cases and retrieving the top-K into a frozen GPT-4.1 planner adds +4.5/+7.0 (HLE), +3.7/+5.3 (SimpleQA), +6.7/+8.2 (DeepResearcher) F1/PM over the same system without memory (Table 5); the learned Q retriever adds about 0.6 points over kNN (Table 4). GAIA test 79.40 is a system-level result with a validation-built bank; the 87.88 validation headline is Pass@3 on the bank-building set (pass@1 70.91). The iteration curve is largely not memory-driven. Not reproduced.

G.reason: Opus sides with son55. The non-weight object (case bank + learned retriever) and its residue (swamping; similarity ≠ utility) are named, but the framing gap (static workflows vs costly fine-tuning) is background, and the nearest neighbours that already store and retrieve trajectories (ExpeL, AWM, Mem0, A-MEM, Agent-KB, DS-Agent) are only listed in prose; the method keeps appending every case, so the stated swamping residue is not addressed. Consistent with G-Memory (r04b), A-MEM (r03a), Dynamic Cheatsheet (r03b) G=2.

M.reason: Opus sides with son55. Write/read are reconstructable, but the M-MDP soft-Q / kernel-EC formalism of §3 is not what is run: the deployed parametric variant collapses to a single-step BCE classifier over (state, case) → task success, so credit assumes the retrieved case caused the outcome (the key assumption is weak, sol's own reason notes 'correlated success not causal case utility'); no distinguishing prediction against plain kNN is stated.

X.reason: Opus sides with son55. Write/read steps and K are explicit, but there is no admission gate, dedup, retirement or rollback, the reward source r∈{0,1} is not specified per benchmark, Q-training schedule is not given, and §3 (every step written) conflicts with §5.3 (final step only). Same level as other append-all memories in this run (G-Memory r04b X=2).

E.measurement.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked and kept with an added defect. GAIA test EM is officially scored, but DeepResearcher/HLE/SimpleQA rely on a GPT-4o-mini judge (F1/PM), the HLE rank and the SimpleQA '95.0 accuracy' compare a PM score with other systems' accuracy figures (opus:O07, opus:O08), and Table 4's metric is unlabelled.

E.causality.reason: Opus sides with son55. A same-system memory-off control exists on three benchmarks and kNN vs Q is compared, but Table 4 shows w/o CBR rising +5.8 over iterations while CBR adds only +0.4–1.8 per iteration (opus:O03, opus:O04), the P-vs-NP gap is <1 point in single runs, Table 3 and Table 5 disagree for the same benchmark (opus:O05, opus:O06), and there is no matched-retry (Pass@3) or random-case control. Table 1 baselines are 7B models from another paper.

E.holdout.reason: Opus sides with son55. The OOD protocol (bank from four datasets, test on three) and the val-built bank reused on hidden GAIA test are real separations, but the GAIA-val headline uses a bank built on the scored questions over three passes (opus:O01), K is selected on the reported benchmark (opus:O10), the OOD per-benchmark values are figure-only (opus:O09), the HLE/SimpleQA bank source is unstated and no overlap audit exists (authors report backbone contamination). sol's 3 credits the GAIA test split, which has no memory-off arm.

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked. Sample sizes (512/125 per dataset, 150/300 GAIA, 4330 SimpleQA, 2500 HLE) and negative results (K>4 plateau, executor drop on DeepResearcher, Level-3 weakness) are reported; every headline is a single run without seeds or intervals while sub-1-point differences are interpreted (A2 rung 1).

E.cost.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked. Only GAIA token counts on 10 sampled tasks per level; no memory-specific cost, no Pass@3-vs-pass@1 budget parity (opus:O02), and the planner/executor are far stronger than the 7B trained baselines.
